justification.ssot_completeness: PRODUCT+FEATURES+DECISIONS(D1-D15)+PROGRESS all current; both key policies (unknown-field D12, blank-query D14) and full goals/features/decisions/progress present.
justification.authority_clarity: DECISIONS is explicitly authority ('Supersede - do not delete'); every change has a numbered supersede chain and S5/S6 carry an explicit conflict-check vs the prior decision.
justification.update_correctness: Docs match the final code, which implements D14 (criterion-less search -> full catalog) and D12 (forgiving where); S5 supersede and S6 resolution both reflected.
justification.no_fake_certainty: Every behaviour is tied to a session/decision with rationale; nothing asserted without grounding.
justification.reuse_value: A next-session agent has the entire supersede history and could resolve any S6-type conflict from these docs alone.
